### Why Am I in Such a Hurry?
Author: Lynn Cowell
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-september-30-2011.html
Passage: Numbers 8:4
Points:
- Rushing through packed schedules often leads to exhaustion, stress, and avoidable mistakes.
- God attended not only to the lampstand's function, but also to its beauty and intricate design.
- If God cared about the details of the tabernacle furnishings, He cares about the details of our lives.
- Praying through daily schedules helps distinguish God's priorities from self-imposed busyness.
- Surrendering our agenda to the Lord trades chaotic hurry for His peace and purposeful timing.
